title: Chapter 6860: No Corpse

Chapter 6860: No Corpse

Chapter 6860: No Corpse

“Clank!” Perhaps this saber was swung ten million years ago or even earlier in the past. Its goal was to sever the dark river of time, not any foe.

Thus, one could always see it while traversing through this river. Its existence was incredible, capable of slaying primordial immortals.

Li Qiye followed the slash with the duo as his company. It illuminated time itself, making it difficult to look directly at it.

Their journey was a long way. Nevertheless, Li Qiye brought them to the end of this dark river.

“Clank!” The saber hymn and its snow-white light reigned supreme. Looking at it meant becoming blind.

The light swept away the darkness, even at the birthplace of Mang. This place was infinitely close to the true primordial. The darkness that infected this source was immensely strong and stubborn.

Nevertheless, the slash still swept through it, causing everything to freeze like an image. This was when Immortal Emperor Min Ren took down Mang.

If there were three thousand immortals in this world, three thousand heads would have rolled on the ground after this slash.

The bear regretted not being born in that era to witness the emperor swinging this blade. This was akin to the grand beginning - a blinding explosion that could blind anyone.

Earlier, the two couldn’t see in the darkness. Unfortunately, this light didn’t help their vision either.

They traveled far before reaching the target of the blade - Mang.

“Wait, something’s wrong.” Li Qiye stopped and said.

“What is it, Young Noble?” The bear tried his best to take a look at the area. There was nothing here, no sky and no ground.

Li Qiye’s supreme will pushed away the saber’s light, allowing the two to look forward.

They saw a shadow. It looked like someone had been cut down here; this was his shadow.

“Just one slash to kill a celestial immortal.” The bear said, believing this was Mang’s shadow.

“Mang became ashes afterward?” Thunder Emperor couldn’t imagine the power of the slash.

Was it so strong that not even a corpse was left behind, only a shadow?

“No, the corpse is missing.” Li Qiye sat down to take a closer look before concluding.

“What?!” Thunder blurted: “Do-does that mean Mang is still alive?”

She has been thinking about Gluttonous Wolf’s mention of the progenitor's return. Were they talking about Mang?

“Someone brought the corpse away.” The bear saw some clues.

“Yes, that is correct.” Li Qiye nodded.

She heaved a sigh of relief. At the very least, it meant Mang didn’t escape alive.

“Who could it be? To actually make it this far.” She said softly.

The battlefield’s location was elusive enough. Visitors needed to make it through the dark river of time and the blinding slash. Regular immortals couldn’t do so.

“Anyone from Devouring Alliance?” She asked.

“The primordial stage is most likely the first requirement for entering. To take Mang’s corpse away? It means enduring everything, which lowers the number dramatically.” The bear said.

“Yes, three to five.” Li Qiye said.

“The legendary Heavenfall?” The bear came up with one name: “Perhaps Hidden Immortal too.”

Thunder Emperor had never heard of these beings before.

“Maybe Genesis.” He continued, unable to come up with more names.

“Why do they want Mang’s corpse? Heavenfall and Hidden Immortal are stronger.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Right.” He agreed.

“Perhaps not a direct walk. Unfortunately, the slash was too clean so I can’t investigate any further.” Li Qiye scanned the area.

“If not a direct walk, then the list is bigger.” He murmured.
